Priya: FYI discovered that a partner integration had Decrypt on our KMS key and a few wrapped tokens landed in staging logs (s3://redwood-logs/staging/integrations/2026-11-07/part-12.log). Paging @eng-security.

Sam: Can you paste a redacted line and object path?

Priya: redacted: `2026-11-07T11:03:02Z INFO payload={"partner_id":"acme","wrapped_token":"KMS:C1y...==","meta":"..."}` Object: s3://redwood-logs/staging/integrations/2026-11-07/part-12.log

Derek: Is that cross-account decrypt? Arun changed keypolicy earlier to grant partner role decrypt for the integration onboarding.

Aria: Triage P2. Plan: 1) snapshot object to secure archive (chain-of-custody) 2) remove public ACL and overwrite with scrubbed version 3) ask partner to rotate any tokens possibly decrypted 4) revoke cross-account KMS grant and evaluate per-tenant wrapping 5) implement SIEM rule for KMS ciphertext in logs.

Priya: Running archive now, will include md5 and operator tag.

security-bot: Incident created INC-2026-1107-3; severity=P2; assigned to eng-security oncall.

Priya: Archive copy complete: s3://redwood-sec-archive/INC-2026-1107-3/part-12.log md5=ab12... perms=admins-only

Derek: Removed public ACL and applied temporary S3 read restriction to logging-service + eng-security. Noted: do not overwrite until archive confirmed.

Priya: Overwrote public object with scrubbed file and header pointing to archive + incident id.

Aria: Messaged partner security requesting rotation and signed attestation. Also asked them to confirm whether they used our KMS for wrapping or their own.

Partner-Sec: Confirmed they used cross-account decrypt to validate tokens and will rotate any tokens in exposure window. They requested guidance to migrate to partner-managed wrapping.

Derek: I drafted KMS key policy change to remove cross-account Decrypt and recommended use of encryption context + grant-limited workflow. I'll open PR for key-policy rollback and per-partner wrapping patterns.

Sam: Added SIEM detection rule to flag any objects with pattern `KMS:[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{8,}` landing in logs and a CloudTrail rule for public ACL changes on log prefixes.

Aria: Post-incident actions: 1) remove cross-account decrypt from key policy (Derek) 2) add pre-ingest redaction for KMS ciphertext (devex) 3) lifecycle policy for staging logs to 7d unless archived (infra) 4) RBAC review for log access and enforce MFA (people-ops+sec) 5) update partner onboarding docs about wrapping options (partnerships+product)

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-1107-3 resolved at 11:50 UTC (auto) — pending postmortem.

Priya: No evidence of exfil; partner rotated; archived originals sealed. I'll write the postmortem and open GH tasks for follow-ups. Thanks all :thumbsup:
